name: Darius
description: Ruler living at the time of Exile and Return

points: So Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and of Cyrus the Persian. He had a wise and humble spirit, was beloved by the king, could answer visions and interpret dreams, and was of the king's seed as shown in chapter one.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, made king over the realm of the Chaldeans, Daniel understood by the books the seventy years of the desolations of Jerusalem spoken to Jeremiah.
This is the same Darius dealt with when the Persians and Medes were shown in chapters 7 and 8.
In the first year of Darius the Mede, the messenger stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

note.label: Daniel 11: The Kings of the North and the South
